profile.name: Monica O'Reilly-Jacob, PhD, APRN, FNP-BC, FAAN, FAANP
profile.title: Assistant Professor of Nursing
profile.office: 560 West 168th Street, Office 634, New York, NY 10032
profile.bio: Monica O'Reilly-Jacob, PhD, APRN, FNP-BC, FAAN, FAANP, is a family nurse practitioner and nursing health services researcher at Columbia University School of Nursing. Her research examines the primary care nurse practitioner workforce, value-based payment models, and emerging models of care such as NP-owned practices and home-based primary care, drawing on national Medicare claims analyses and statewide surveys. She currently leads a multidisciplinary team studying NP-owned practice readiness for value-based payment, funded by the American Nurses Foundation.
